title: Virtual Data Room Features For Controlled Document Sharing
subtitle: Room capabilities for teams that need high-fidelity viewing, multilingual public links, permissions, watermarking, DocYantra-backed redaction, and privacy-first analytics.
gridTitle: Features that keep teams in control after the room goes live
gridSubtitle: Use DocKosha for repeat diligence workflows, client-facing deal rooms, and sensitive document sharing with stronger controls than generic file tools, including multilingual public link experiences.

sections.title: Security that fits live deal work
sections.description: Protect confidential documents with encryption, dynamic watermarking, and room permissions designed for active external review.

sections.title: High-fidelity client-facing viewer
sections.description: Present CIMs, contracts, models, and diligence files cleanly across desktop and mobile with high-fidelity rendering through DocKosha Cloud’s validated processing path.

sections.title: Multilingual public links
sections.description: Set a workspace default language for public links, then override it per link when needed. DocKosha-owned viewer copy, gate screens, and recipient emails stay aligned for international sharing.

sections.title: Engagement signals you can act on
sections.description: See what got opened, revisited, and downloaded with privacy-first analytics. Viewer-level identity appears only when your gates require it.

sections.title: Verified commenting in context
sections.description: Keep review cycles moving with threaded comments pinned to highlighted text. Commenting requires verification, so feedback stays tied to real viewers.

sections.title: Versioning without link churn
sections.description: Replace files without breaking room links. Keep version history with retention controls, preview, and one-click restore from the internal viewer.

sections.title: Virtual data rooms for diligence
sections.description: Organize folders for buy-side, sell-side, and diligence workflows, then control access with NDA or email gates, expirations, and granular allow rules down to folders and documents.

sections.title: Analytics that answer follow-up questions
sections.description: Track views, time per page, downloads, and engagement so teams know what got reviewed. Export viewer insights to CSV when needed.

sections.title: Link-level controls and gating
sections.description: Customize each link: require verification, set allowlists or blocklists, apply presets, set expirations, limit downloads, and enforce viewer rules inside data rooms.

sections.title: Custom URLs
sections.description: Create cleaner room and document links with custom URL paths that make client-facing sharing look intentional.

sections.title: Secure PDF redaction
sections.description: DocKosha Cloud permanently removes sensitive information from PDFs and converted documents within its validated processing envelope. Save as a new file or replace the current version while preserving links and history.

sections.title: Audit trails
sections.description: Keep an owner-only audit log of key activity like uploads, deletes, renames, link changes, and access updates across documents and data rooms.

supported.title: Supported File Types for Online Viewing
supported.subtitle: DocKosha supports text, images, video, and audio. DocKosha Cloud converts supported modern Office formats — including documents with Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text — into PDFs for consistent viewing, watermarking, and analytics within its validated envelope. Legacy .doc, .ppt, and .xls uploads are not supported.
items: Text: PDF, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, XLSM, CSV, MD
Video: MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WEBM

privacy.title: Privacy-First Document Analytics
privacy.subtitle: Get useful insights without over-collecting. Analytics are anonymized by default and designed to avoid storing unnecessary PII in external review workflows.
items: Anonymized by default; viewer email is collected only when link settings require it
No raw IP storage; country is derived transiently
Email collection occurs only when explicit link settings (like Email Verification, NDA, or Allowlists/Blocklists) require it
CSV export is available for document viewer insights; broader exports (data rooms/workspace) are coming soon

cta.subtitle: Start with the room controls your team actually needs, then upgrade as volume, storage, and collaboration grow.
